Name: Hammer and Anvil
Description: A smith's manual gone to war: how to put the whole body behind a mace. The skill trainer can teach what it describes.

Name: Shieldbearer's Drill
Description: Parade-ground drills for the shield line, annotated in a soldier's hand. The skill trainer can teach what it describes.

Name: Fletcher's Manual
Description: Shafts, heads and the draw that suits each. The skill trainer can teach what it describes.

Name: Grimoire of Embers
Description: Its pages are warm to the touch. The skill trainer can teach what it describes.

Name: Rime Codex
Description: Frost furs the binding however long it sits by the fire. The skill trainer can teach what it describes.

Name: Storm Letters
Description: A bundle of correspondence between two weather-mages, each trying to outdo the other. The skill trainer can teach what it describes.

Name: Ossuary Rites
Description: Bound in something pale. It explains, patiently, how to ask the dead for a favour. The skill trainer can teach what it describes.
